timing_method: PIXAL_TIMING synchronizes HIP before and after measured segments. It adds a small amount of instrumentation overhead; all comparable variants used the same timing mode.

failed_experiment.name: skip_empty_cache
failed_experiment.result: CuMesh out-of-memory during GLB simplification/remeshing; no completed GLB or end-to-end time. Keep cache clearing enabled.

interpretation: The 1024 cascade breaks out of the max_num_tokens resolution loop at 1024, so changing max_num_tokens does not alter this pipeline's resolution or token count.
Each run is a single measurement. Timing differences of a few seconds may be normal run-to-run variation.

The inspection renders show the 10-step silhouette close to 12 steps, but with a visible texture/color artifact on the base; 8 steps has more visibly incoherent details. These are not broad quality evaluations.

A 50,000-point bidirectional surface comparison against the 12-step mesh gives mean nearest-surface distances of 0.004786 model units (10 steps) and 0.004918 (8 steps). This measures only geometric proximity, not topology, texture quality, or correctness against ground truth.
BF16 NAF is substantially slower than the FP16 baseline on this test.

surface_comparison.method: 50,000 deterministic area-weighted surface samples per mesh; symmetric nearest-surface distance
surface_comparison.limitation: Relative mesh comparison only; not ground-truth accuracy and not sensitive to all topology or appearance defects.
